<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY ent 'Parsed Entity'>">
  %param;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?target data="processing instruction"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Comment containing various constructs &ent; -->
  <sub:child id="c1">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA section with markup: <child>&ent;</child> ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha Value">
  <!ENTITY beta "α and Beta">
  <!ENTITY % dtdMacro "<!ELEMENT note (#PCDATA)>">
  %dtdMacro;
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "guide.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://w3.org/inventory" xmlns:inv="http://w3.org/inventory/detail">
  <!-- Top-level comment before PIs and entities -->
  <inv:note>
    <?custom-pi action="process"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA text including entities like β and tags <item>.
    ]]>
  </inv:note>
  <item>β</item>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (product)*>
  <!ELEMENT product (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY derived "&base;Derived">
  <!ENTITY % extEnt "<!ENTITY deep 'Nested &derived;'>">
  %extEnt;
  <?pi-target instruction-data?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://schema.org/catalog" xmlns:p="http://schema.org/product">
  <!-- Comment emphasizing deep entity and CDATA interaction -->
  <p:product id="p1">
    <![CDATA[
      <!DOCTYPE nested-cdata-attempt>
      <tag>&deep;</tag>
    ]]>
  </p:product>
  <product>&deep;</product>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY token "SecureToken">
  <!ENTITY % externalDecl "<!ENTITY secureEnt '&token;-Verified'>">
  %externalDecl;
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY readme SYSTEM "README.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<archive xmlns="http://ietf.org/archive" xmlns:arc="http://ietf.org/archive/spec">
  <!-- Comment detailing security considerations -->
  <arc:record>
    <?arc-pi debug="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block enclosing &secureEnt; & readme references.
    ]]>
  </arc:record>
  <record>&secureEnt;</record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE registry [
  <!ELEMENT registry (entry)*>
  <!ELEMENT entry (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY val "RegistryValue">
  <!ENTITY % localMacro "<!ATTLIST entry category CDATA #IMPLIED>">
  %localMacro;
  <?registry-log level="debug"?>
]>
<registry xmlns="http://org.registry" xmlns:reg="http://org.registry/ns">
  <!-- Multi-line comment 
       spanning several lines 
       with &val; and other symbols -->
  <reg:entry category="primary">
    <?reg-pi action="refresh"?>
    <![CDATA[
      <reg:entry>Inner CDATA &val;</reg:entry>
    ]]>
  </reg:entry>
  <entry>&val;</entry>
</registry>
```
